mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing the cost of capital and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, leading to reduced corporate revenue growth and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns with a Rank IC below 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY), a rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, which suppresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% and FEDFUNDS is above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 102.0 for three consecutive months indicates robust supply chain activity and economic expansion, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has been above 102.0 for three months.

mechanism_narrative: When the quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) falls below 1.0% annualized for two consecutive quarters, it signals economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 is below 1.0% annualized for two quarters.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a sharp increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs in a month signals overheating labor market, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 200,000 and UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in real interest rates (FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL) indicates a shift toward stagflation, reducing corporate profit margins and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising CPIAUCSL and falling real rates fails to predict negative 20-day returns with a Rank IC below 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.
